notes.title: Copy Kitty Version 3.3
notes.content:
Hello again! It's been 2 years since the last update, and we've mostly been working on our new game, [url=http://entanma.com/sunfluffs/]Sunfluffs[/url]! A game's development is never finished though, and we've built up a lot of small changes we wanted to make over the past few years.

[h3]Big changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Deck compatibility
[*] Added gamepad button graphics (Xbox, PS4, Switch, Steam Deck). If the buttons don't display correctly, try disabling Steam Input in Steam's right-click menu for the game.
[*] Better control config screen
[*] New character select art
[/list]
[h3]Smaller stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*]World 12 for Savant plays Blackberry instead of Tangerine
[*]Text readability is improved
[*]Shadow Joust hitbox bug fixed
[*]Small balancing adjustments to certain Yoggvals
[*]Fixed start-of-level iframes being different on a first play than a restart in some levels
[*]Fixed a certain checkpoint trigger so you can't skip segments with the "Restart from Checkpoint" button
[*]Custom boss Disaro can't be easily stunlocked with up-kicks anymore
[*]Phoenix Yoggval can't be softlocked by using an emote between phases
[*]Sound adjustments (like on Thremnats) to make it not overlap weirdly if a lot play at once
[*]Boki's final boss has various graphical tweaks for readability, and slight balance changes
[*]Fortress Virs core phase lasers are slightly easier
[*]Speedrun Mode now properly saves W12 hard mode times
[/list]
If you find any major bugs with the update, [url=https://twitter.com/AzureLazuline]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/kHdnYwD]Discord[/url] are the fastest ways to get in contact.

notes.title: Copy Kitty version 3.2.1 is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25638256/29b2da2e0396267bb437566d844c8e5409d11a7c.png[/img]

Version 3.2.1 is out! This is mostly a bug fix update for the level editor and for speedruns.

[h1]Custom level fixes:[/h1][list][*] Philyk available as a new custom boss!
[*] Hixants no longer suck up pressure plates when creating the boss.
[*] Enemies that use Nuclear Annihilator can now drop Mega Missile.
[*] Gaddron bosses in levels with no ceiling won't randomly leave and despawn.
[*] Greljant bosses properly let you pick both of their weapons now.
[/list]

[h1]Other changes:[/h1][list][*] The game makes backup saves more often to hopefully prevent data loss.
[*] Fixed the speedrun timer still running during 4-2's intro and during the ending.
[*] Small visual changes to the main menu.
[*] Absolver Orzinav has less HP.
[*] When playing as a Yolomo, the sky and fire Yoggvals let you properly fight them.
[*] Sun Fist Yolomo and Polar Yolomo are easier to access.
[*] One more playable Construct subtype added, via a secret modifier combination.
[/list]

Our website also has a bunch of [b][url=http://entanma.com/wallpapers]downloadable wallpapers[/url][/b] now! And the game's on sale for [b]70% off[/b] up until May 6, so grab it while you can!

notes.title: Copy Kitty version 3.2 is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25638256/89c57940c5c661cde5c6d707e30a63fd3974b275.png[/img]

[h1]Big changes:[/h1][list][*] Custom bosses in the editor! Power up any enemy type and give it up to 3 phases.
[*] 3 new outfits for Boki! They're unlocked from beating certain levels/environments.
[*] The level editor is available on the demo version now!
[*] Plenty of new art in the gallery.
[*] You can taunt/emote by pushing the Drop button at the same time as up or down.
[*] New song for certain bosses in Endless Mode, by guest composer Bionic Dog.
[*] New modifier: Slow-Mo, for speedrun practice. Replays play at normal speed.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes and small changes:[/h1][list][*] Fixed a pretty bad Speedrun Mode glitch where the timer would reset after 2-9.
[*] Fixed softlock after Yolomacho in speedrun mode.
[*] Fixed some problems with the speedrun mode timer in IL's for the final boss.
[*] Fixed occasional camera glitch in TNT Tunnel.
[*] Fixed Thremnat shields being unable to block base Lightning fired left.
[*] Removed all Hoagall RNG in story mode.
[*] Added "use super shot!" prompt to Exchikkalibur if you go too long without it.
[*] Fixed replays for Treacherous Maze.
[*] Adjusted graphics in one of Savant's bosses to make attack tells easier to see.
[*] Adjusted graphics in Exchikkalibur hard mode for the same reason.
[*] Boss death hints only play after 3 deaths now, instead of 2. (Worldbuilding/joke scenes can still play after 1 or 2 deaths.)
[/list]

notes.title: Copy Kitty version 3.0.2 released, Steam Workshop added!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25638256/64c3599f62d2df93b8236a3dca35f35f74cd5191.jpg[/img]

New version's out! The main thing is [b]Steam Workshop support[/b] so everyone can share their custom levels! Once you get the update, go to the Story Mode screen and select "custom levels".

Other changes:
[list][*]Some enemy behavior changes and balancing
[*]Better tutorial for Savant
[*]New sounds for several enemies
[*]Bug/crash fixes
[/list]

The game's 25% off in the Steam sale, so grab it soon!

notes.title: Version 2.11 Release
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25638256/f4a605078f5b5a5b12dd2565f364467df49f5c95.png[/img]

[b]Version 2.11 change log:[/b]

• Several crash fixes and other bug fixes.
• Maps added during the stage transitions.
• Some small level changes and one new level in the forest.
• World 11 weapons added to the star menu.
• Level editor has preset graphic themes for Tundra and Ruins.
• Database has all the new W11 enemies (and some old ones that weren't in it yet).
• Main menu song upgrade! The old one was from 3 years ago.
• Hard Mode bonus levels re-added (absent from 2.1 because of time constraints).

This is just a small fixup patch before we start working on the big full release!

notes.title: Version 2.1 Release
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25638256/2f0cbd23a7eea3df20c5cbee033e6b4681d605cf.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25638256/a7a32da6d0f76c5daacd5afb45c5a5628c6f282c.png[/img]

[b]Version 2.1 change log:[/b]

• World 11 (has 10 levels + 2 bosses)
• Intermission scenes in Endless
• New earlygame levels + enemies
• Completely new menus that are way cooler
• General polishing and touch-ups

There's some really minor stuff like the database entries that weren't finished in time, but I really just wanted to get this main content out there after 6 months of working on it! It's a pretty big upgrade over the last release.
